shortDescription: Configures Service Profile Association on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: org_dn
options.description: The distinguished name (dn) of the organization where the resource is assigned.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: restrict_migration
options.description: Restricts the migration of the service profile after it has been associated with a server. If set to no, Cisco UCS Manager does not perform any compatibility checks on the new server before migrating the existing service profile. If set to no and the hardware of both servers used in migration are not similar, the association might fail.

options.name: server_assignment
options.description: Specifies how to associate servers with this service profile using the following choices: server - Use to pre-provision a slot or select an existing server.  Slot or server is specified by the server_dn option. pool - Use to select from a server pool.  The server_pool option specifies the name of the server pool to use. Option is not valid if the service profile is bound to a template. Optional if the state is absent.

options.name: server_dn
options.description: The Distinguished Name (dn) of the server object used for pre-provisioning or selecting an existing server. Required if the server_assignment option is server. Optional if the state is absent.

options.name: server_pool_name
options.description: Name of the server pool used for server pool based assignment. Required if the server_assignment option is pool. Optional if the state is absent.

options.name: service_profile_name
options.description: The name of the Service Profile being associated or disassociated.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify service profile association and associate with specified server or server pool if needed. If C(absent), will verify service profile is not associated and will disassociate if needed.  This is the same as specifying Assign Later in the webUI.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
